name: Familial Isolated Café-au-Lait Macules

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Familial Isolated Café-au-Lait Macules

criteria.description: Presence of six or more café-au-lait macules larger than 5 mm in prepubertal individuals or larger than 15 mm in postpubertal individuals
Positive family history of isolated café-au-lait macules without other systemic features
Absence of diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 or other syndromic causes of café-au-lait macules

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multiple café-au-lait macules with positive family history and exclusion of neurofibromatosis type 1 or other syndromes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and requires exclusion of other genetic disorders associated with café-au-lait macules.

pathognomonic.notes: Uniformly pigmented light brown macules with smooth borders

pathognomonic.symptomName: Familial occurrence of isolated café-au-lait macules
pathognomonic.notes: Positive family history without systemic involvement

common.symptomName: Hyperpigmented macules with smooth 'coast of California' borders
common.notes: Typical border morphology distinguishing from other pigmented lesions

common.symptomName: Stable size and number of café-au-lait macules over time

common.notes: No cutaneous neurofibromas or plexiform neurofibromas
Freckling typical of NF1 is absent
searchTerms: no freckles in armpits or groin
no small dark spots in skin folds
lack of freckling in body creases

occasional.notes: Some macules may show slight heterogeneity in color
searchTerms: slight color differences in skin spots

occasional.notes: Rare small pigmented spots not meeting criteria for freckling

occasional.symptomName: Family members with variable expressivity of macules
occasional.notes: Number and size of macules may vary among affected relatives
searchTerms: family members with different skin spot appearances
variable skin patch patterns in relatives
mild itching on some skin spots

rare.notes: Rarely, isolated neurofibromas may appear without fulfilling NF1 criteria

rare.symptomName: Presence of café-au-lait macules with irregular borders

rare.notes: Rare reports of minor bone dysplasia without systemic syndrome

other: Clinical exclusion of neurofibromatosis type 1 and other syndromes
Family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

redFlags: Development of neurofibromas or plexiform neurofibromas
Presence of axillary or inguinal freckling
Onset of neurological symptoms such as seizures or cognitive decline
references: National Organization for Rare Disorders (NORD) - Familial Isolated Café-au-Lait Macules
